data.body:
Fix pushed as Gerrit change 1112 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1112).

REPRODUCED, not taken on trust. find_referencing_symbols('AcliRestMixin/set_entity_property', 'src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli_rest.py') -> {} while grep finds three call sites. Two corrections to the ticket's citations: apply_inbound_records.py is :231, not :279; and _update_one_apply_reporter lives in dispatch_apply_phases.py:91, not dispatch_one.py. dispatch_one.py:321 and binding_store.py:517 are exact.

DISCRIMINATING EXPERIMENT (kills 'Serena is broken' / 'that file is unindexed'): find_referencing_symbols on AcliRestMixin/_direct_rest_put_raw — same class, same file — returns 5 references across 3 files, including one through a local 'client' in jira-capability-probe.py:98 where the receiver type is INFERRED from 'client = AcliClient(...)' at :73. The TicketTransport control also holds.

ROOT CAUSE SHARPENED — the ticket says 'UNANNOTATED parameter', which is only part of it. binding_store.py:479 declares 'def recover_pending_bindings(self, client: Any, ...)' — an EXPLICIT annotation — and is missed identically. The real discriminator is the receiver's static type being Any, implicit or explicit. The shipped wording says so.

RED->GREEN: tests/unit/test_agents_serena_untyped_receiver.py, seen RED (5/5) before the fix, GREEN after, returned to RED by deleting the new table row.

NOTE / follow-up: scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py emits the reminder on every Bash call and still enumerates only the string-literal and line-number cases. It now under-describes the rule. It was left untouched (out of this ticket's scope) and it carries a hard 3-line cap enforced by tests/unit/test_serena_grep_reminder_hook.py::test_reminder_is_at_most_three_lines, so fitting a fourth case needs its own decision.
